kind: Offline fight-centric opportunity estimate; conditional, biased sample

sample.selection_bias: fights chosen for Druid Balance DPS Alliance subject and cohort

nominal_actor_boss_slots.meaning: configurations x (subject + cohort) x bosses; not fights or requests

cohort_presence_threshold.condition: distinct same-configuration characters (the measurement subject excluded) present in captured fights for that boss within a DPS rank bucket; cells count 5 or more, slot share counts up to 5 per cell
cohort_presence_threshold.not_eligibility: selection, faction-qualified ranking row, ownership, metric and stream completeness are not proved for any of these characters

measured_costs.grouping_note: a grouping opportunity within each scope only; acquisition and finalization stay independent, and merged answers are not proved equivalent
measured_costs.points: not modelled: account-wide readings, hidden database allowance

subject_coverage_limit: Report bundles hold only the selected fights (1-3 per report here), so a single session's full-clear coverage cannot be measured from this archive; the per-report figures are a floor set by selection, not a property of the raids.
limits: One configuration's capture; other configurations' leaderboards were not read.
Rank is the DPS-metric global rank; it is not cohort eligibility (same faction, ownership, the configuration's own ranking row and stream completeness).
Reports are separate sessions; guilds are context only.
